content.text: Can we turn this entire repo and project (paperclip) into being hosted by cloudflare exclusively? Ideally I would like this to be something I have a one button "install on cloudflare" on the readme for example, and then it automatically runs itself on my cloudflare account, installing whatever it may need. instead of postgres we would use the cloudflare d1, r2, etc. And use pages and workers, right?
